properties.description: The 225 integration test files in crates/reflow2-core/tests/ are consolidated into 4 test programs: in_memory (223 files as modules), on_disk (1), on_disk_fulltext (1), and the_schema_is_parsed_once (1, isolated for its LazyLock cold-path test). Test discovery is off; a guard test reads Cargo.toml and fails if any file is missing from all programs. Build artifact size drops from ~4.9 GB to ~100 MB (no features). 1909 tests before = 1909 after + 3 guard tests.
properties.name: reflow2-core's test files compile into a few programs, not one each
